fusions.name: Talon Stoop
fusions.desc: A stooping snatch at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Mantling Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft in a full circle, dealing 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Off the Glove
fusions.desc: Looses a hawk for 10 seconds that strikes for 3 damage every second within 4 tiles. Each strike of its talons has a 35% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Raptor
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a talon strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
